description: A fixed point of an agent graph's canvas, in pixels from the canvas's top-left corner — the type a host uses to pin a node exactly where it wants it through TmAgentGraph.NodePositions. Pinning is the escape hatch for a surface whose node order matters to the reader (a hand-placed architecture sketch, a restored layout): a pinned node keeps its exact coordinate and everything else is still laid out around it, and the canvas grows so the pinned box is never cut off.

members.name: X
members.description: Distance in pixels from the canvas's left edge; never negative (a negative or non-finite value is stored as zero).

members.name: Y
members.description: Distance in pixels from the canvas's top edge; never negative (a negative or non-finite value is stored as zero).
